name: Disable Heuristics
description: Disables Windows scaling heuristics to stop the system from auto-adjusting TCP settings, providing a more consistent and stable network connection
commands:
netsh int tcp set heuristics disabled
 
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=disabled
revert22H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revert23H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revert24H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revertCommands:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
